about_the_game:
Play online with up to 10 players (5v5) as Hunters and Mimics will battle it out in hilariously sneaky and strategic first/third person gameplay. 

Players will swap between the Hunters and Mimics as they constantly trying to best the other team in a modern take on Prop Hunt style gameplay. Both sides have an arsenal of abilities to unlock and use to their advantage!

Headphones are highly recommended, as sound is one of the most important ways to detect the dreaded Mimics!

The Hunters (First Person)

A team of Hunters summoned from across the galaxy; they will stop at nothing to destroy the Mimic Man's essence once and for all.

  • Win by eliminating all enemy team Mimics before time runs out.

  • Listen closely - the vociferating cry of a Mimic will reveal its location.

  • Unlock and use 26 different Hunter Gear with various advantages. Choose abilities that fit your playstyle and support your team! 

The Mimics (Third Person)

Created from the Mimic Man's essence, The Mimics will do anything they can to survive and continue to spread chaos throughout the universe.

  • Win by having at least one Mimic survive until time runs out or by killing all the Hunters.

  • Stay on the move or hide when necessary -- Hunters will desperately try to eliminate you!

  • Unlock and use 26 different Mimic Evolutions with various advantages. Choose abilities that fit your playstyle and support your team! 

Features

  • Customization: Player models, hats, abilities, vociferations, victory poses, and more!

  • Two primary Gameplay Modes:

    • Compulsive Vociferation

      • Mimics are forced to vociferate automatically against their will.

    • Soul Decay

      • Mimics must vociferate willingly or die.

  • Multiplayer physics replication.

  • Level up to unlock a total of 52 different abilities split between Hunters and Mimics!

Planned Post-Release

  • Gear and Evolution specialization skill tree

    • Spend earned skill points to specialize your Hunter or Mimic abilities even further!

  • New maps

  • New Gear and Evolutions

  • More hats, Hunters, and Mimic Variants!

short_description: Mimic Man is a team based 5v5 multi-player tactical hybrid first/third person shooter. Team up with friends to defeat the opposing team in an ultimate battle of action and wits. Hunters must eliminate mimics quickly, but beware, for Mimics will disguise, sabotage and taunt you to stay alive.
